services_subhead: From interior feature walls to full exterior repaints, we handle every job with meticulous attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls finished to a high standard. We prep properly, use quality paints, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes that protect and refresh. Includes guttering, fascias, soffits, and cladding work.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging
services.desc: Professional wallpaper installation with precise pattern matching and neat trimming. We remove old paper and prepare surfaces properly.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, architraves, and fitted furniture painted to perfection. Expert brush technique for a smooth, hard-wearing finish.

services.title: Decorative Effects
services.desc: Faux finishes, murals, accent walls, and bespoke colour consultation. Create character and personality in any room.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office spaces, retail units, and hospitality venues refreshed professionally. We work around your schedule with minimal disruption.

about_pullquote: We turn up when we say we will, finish the job right, and charge you fairly.
about_para_1: Spotty Dog Decorators was born from frustration. I spent years watching cowboys cut corners and overcharge homeowners across Newcastle. I decided to do it differently — proper preparation, quality materials, and honest pricing. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation one happy customer at a time, completing over 500 projects across the city and surrounding areas.
about_para_2: Our repeat customer rate speaks volumes: three out of every four jobs come from homeowners who've used us before or who've been recommended by friends. We take pride in the detail — from moving furniture carefully to hoovering up every speck of dust before we leave. That's why Newcastle families keep calling us back.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us
